structure.parts: Explicit instrument parts with one or more staves
structure.piano: Two staves in the same part
structure.both: Notation and TAB describe the same musical events

label_conventions.duration: Positive duration denominator and positive tuplet counts; onset units are 960 ticks per quarter.
label_conventions.trill: Notation targets the visible trill mark; TAB and BOTH retain the visible auxiliary fret/pitch. Playback rate uses the export default.
label_conventions.grace: Visible pitch/fret, transition and applicable slash/dead markings; playback-only duration is normalized.
label_conventions.bend: Visible bend type and height; GP5 uses the corresponding canonical contour.
label_conventions.chord_marks: Notation chord-wide accent, heavy and staccato counts are anchored in descending pitch order.
label_conventions.state: Printed time/key signatures are read visually and propagated; neighbouring measure images provide context.
label_conventions.chord_names: URL-encoded visible chord symbols attached to musical onset; preserve accidentals and slash bass.
label_conventions.chord_diagrams: Actual visible absolute frets, open/muted strings, fingers and barres; low-to-high string arrays.
label_conventions.page_chord_library: Retained separately; attach fingering only to a matching timed symbol in the same part.
label_conventions.text_encoding: Native GP text is decoded before engraving; legacy targets follow the text actually printed.
label_conventions.staff_identity: Visible instrument name, family and TAB string count; rare printed abbreviations are balanced in training.
label_conventions.tuning: Unusual fretted tunings use consistent notation/TAB evidence; a generic Standard label cannot override visual pitches on four/five-string guitar tracks.

export.wide_or_dense_melodic_parts: Partitioned into GP5-compatible tracks while retaining the complete score document.

pitch_reference.guitar: MIDI pitch before the separate track capo
pitch_reference.bass: MIDI pitch before the separate track capo

adapter_notation_output: written MIDI pitches when pitch context is provided; converted to stored pitches before validation, review and export

pitch_context.clef: G2, F4, C3, C4, percussion; TAB information is ignored for musical pitch
pitch_context.octave_spans: horizontal fraction of each measure, with semitones and original region provenance
pitch_context.ottava: event annotation -24, -12, 12 or 24, notes already resolved; export preserves engraving without shifting again
pitch_context.evidence: Chord symbols and techniques cannot establish transposition; explicit pitch evidence is required.
